G1.rationale: The principal result is a computed recovery rate from measured radioactivity and shoot biomass, and the analysis is described as performed in R, so a third party can re-run the computation on deposited data.

quotes.quote: AMF communities in grassland soils were much more efficient in acquiring 33 P and transferred 64% more 33 P to plants compared to AMF in cropland soils.
The recovery of 33 P was 64% higher in pots filled with soils from grassland sites compared to the soils from croplands (p<0.001; Fig. 2 ).

G2.rationale: The abstract and first results sentence state a principal numerical endpoint: 64% higher 33P recovery in grassland vs cropland soils.

specification.blind_target: The difference in hyphal 33P transfer, measured as 33P recovery in Plantago lanceolata shoots, between pots filled with grassland soils and pots filled with cropland soils.

specification.input_notes: The deposit listing contains only database_33P_2204.xlsx. The paper states data are available at 10.6084/m9.figshare.15134328. It is not clear from the listing whether this file contains the raw 33P recovery values, shoot weights, injected radioactivity, and land-use labels needed to compute the 64% difference.

leakage_files.name: database_33P_2204.xlsx
leakage_files.reason: If this file contains the computed 33P recovery rates or summary tables, it would leak the target value or derived result tables.

specification.comparison_metric: Compare the reported 64% higher 33P recovery in grassland vs cropland soils and the reported p<0.001 from a Wilcoxon rank test with the same quantities computed from the deposited data.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: The 64% difference should match within the displayed rounding bin; the p-value should be <0.001 at the reported precision.
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify in the main text whether the 64% is based on mean, median, or model-derived recovery rates, nor whether it is a ratio of means or a back-transformed log-scale estimate. The exact handling of missing values and the exact subset used for the Wilcoxon test are not fully specified in the main text.
